services.name: Data health check
services.get: A score out of 100 and a list of problems: duplicates, gaps, wrong codes
services.data: Whatever files you have
services.missing: Nothing extra: it works on anything you send

services.name: Business snapshot
services.get: Trends, plus your best and worst products, customers and branches
services.data: A sales list: date, product, amount
services.missing: E-invoices or till receipts work instead

services.name: Data cleaning and merging
services.get: One clean, trusted table built from your scattered files
services.method: Standard cleaning rules, duplicate removal and fuzzy matching of names and codes
services.data: Any Excel, CSV or system exports you have
services.missing: Nothing extra: we work with what you send

services.name: KPI dashboard
services.get: Your key numbers on one screen, refreshed every month
services.method: KPI design with Power BI or Looker Studio
services.data: Monthly sales, costs and any targets you track
services.missing: Missing targets: we suggest them from your own history

services.name: Trends and seasonality
services.get: What really changes by month, weekday and season, with the noise taken out
services.data: At least 12 months of daily or weekly sales
services.missing: Under 12 months: weekday and monthly patterns only

services.name: Driver analysis
services.get: Which factors move your sales or costs the most, and by how much
services.data: Sales plus the factors you think matter: price, promotions, branch, season
services.missing: Missing factors: we add public ones such as holidays and inflation

services.name: Branch and product benchmarking
services.get: Which branches and products under- or over-perform, compared fairly
services.method: Indexed comparison per square metre, per staff member and per customer
services.data: Sales by branch or product, plus size and staff numbers
services.missing: Without size or staff data: sales and growth only

services.name: Sales forecast, 3 to 12 months
services.get: Expected sales per month, with a likely, low and high case
services.data: Two years or more of monthly sales
services.missing: One year still works, with wider ranges. No history: we build it from customers × average order × visits

services.name: Price change what-if
services.get: Whether a price change pays off, and the drop in sales it can survive
services.data: Price and cost per product
services.missing: If prices never changed, we give break-even limits and design a two-week price test

services.name: Product and customer ranking
services.get: The 20% of products and customers that bring 80% of your profit
services.data: Sales by product and by customer
services.missing: Invoices or till data

services.name: Stock reorder plan
services.get: What to order, when, and how much
services.method: Reorder point with safety stock; Croston for slow sellers
services.data: Sales by product, stock on hand, supplier delivery times
services.missing: Delivery times can be your estimate

services.name: Customer groups
services.get: Your best, loyal, at-risk and lost customers
services.data: Orders with customer, date and amount
services.missing: A phone number or a code can stand in for a customer ID

services.name: Ad channel performance
services.get: The cost to win a customer, and the payback time, for each channel
services.method: Acquisition cost, return on ad spend, payback
services.data: Ad spend per channel and new customers
services.missing: No tracking? Promo codes, or a “how did you hear about us?” question, for four weeks

services.name: Budget split across channels
services.get: Where your next EGP 1,000 should go
services.method: Marketing mix modelling (Google Meridian, Meta Robyn)
services.data: Two to three years of weekly spend per channel
services.missing: This one can’t be replaced, so we run a simple test: pause ads in one area and compare

services.name: Customer value and churn
services.get: Who is likely to stop buying, and what each customer is worth
services.method: Cohort analysis and the BG/NBD model
services.data: Twelve months or more of orders per customer
services.missing: With less history, cohort tables only

services.name: A/B test check
services.get: Whether version B really won, or it was luck
services.data: The results of both versions
services.missing: We can help you design the test first

services.name: Error and fraud scan
services.get: A list of suspicious entries for you to review
services.method: Benford’s law, duplicate checks, outlier detection (Isolation Forest), gaps in invoice numbers
services.data: Ledger entries, invoices, bank statements
services.missing: Invoices and bank statements alone still catch duplicates and mismatches. Benford’s law needs a few hundred entries

services.name: Books, e-invoices and bank, matched
services.get: Sales that don’t match your tax records or bank deposits
services.data: E-invoice export, your books, bank statement
services.missing: Any two of the three still work

services.name: 13-week cash forecast
services.get: The week cash runs short, and what to do before it
services.method: Direct cash-flow method, the standard used by banks and finance managers
services.data: Bank balance, unpaid invoices, bills, payroll dates
services.missing: No list of unpaid invoices? We estimate from six months of bank statements

services.name: Profit projection with what-ifs
services.get: Profit for the next 12 months under three scenarios
services.method: Driver-based model with Monte Carlo simulation
services.data: 12 to 24 months of profit and loss
services.missing: Missing costs become your estimates, clearly labelled

services.name: Break-even
services.get: How much you must sell to cover your costs
services.data: Fixed costs, cost per unit, price
services.missing: Your estimates

services.name: Exchange rate and inflation impact
services.get: What the pound at 45, 50 or 55 to the dollar does to your margin
services.data: The share of your costs that is imported
services.missing: Your estimate, plus Central Bank data

services.name: Staff turnover analysis
services.get: Who is likely to leave, and what turnover costs you
services.data: Staff list with hire date, leave date, role, salary
services.missing: Under about 50 staff: turnover rate and cost only, no prediction

services.name: Staffing plan
services.get: Staff needed per hour or day, matched to your sales
services.method: ETS sales forecast with a labour-cost ratio
services.data: Sales by hour and work schedules
services.missing: Daily sales work, with less detail

services.name: Payroll error scan
services.get: Duplicate payments, ghost employees, overtime spikes
services.data: Payroll records
services.missing: Bank transfers to staff can stand in

services.name: Pay fairness check
services.get: Pay gaps by role, tenure and gender
services.data: Salaries, roles, tenure
services.missing: Salary bands can replace exact salaries, with wider ranges

services.name: Employee survey
services.get: A satisfaction score and the main complaints
services.method: eNPS, with AI reading the written comments
services.data: Survey answers
services.missing: We can design and run the survey for you

services.name: Market size
services.get: How big your market is, and your share of it
services.method: TAM, SAM and SOM, top-down and bottom-up
services.data: Mostly public data: CAPMAS, World Bank
services.missing: Public data covers it fully

services.name: Demand trends
services.get: Whether interest is rising or falling, and when it peaks
services.data: Public data
services.missing: Nothing needed from you

services.name: Competitor check
services.get: Competitors’ prices, positioning, and what their customers complain about
services.method: Price comparison, Porter’s five forces, SWOT, AI reading of public reviews
services.data: Competitor prices and reviews, collected by hand
services.missing: We collect what is public

services.name: Customer survey
services.get: What customers want, and what they’ll pay
services.method: Survey statistics and the Van Westendorp price test
services.data: Survey answers
services.missing: We design and run the survey

services.name: Market conditions
services.get: How inflation, interest rates and the pound affect you
services.data: Central Bank of Egypt, CAPMAS, IMF
services.missing: Public data covers it fully
